title: Claude AI terminal scroll issue | 1754510400
body:
**Bug Description**
When I start a command the terminal scrolls to the top and then back to the bottom before I can continue to type or submit the command. Its a really annoying glitch and can cause development to slow considerably because sometimes the terminal window history can get quite long. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 1.0.69
- Feedback ID: c83ed9ad-eec8-4fbf-abd8-515bb3f3c915
